serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: And? Any thoughts?
Bot: Several. If alloyman is so smart, why did he not construct an automated android like myself, but instead a suit? His fragile body inside is his biggest weakness.
Oh no. She’s the nit-picking type….
You: W-well, he does it in Alloyman 5, but I don’t want to spoil things for you.
Bot: His girlfriend. Is she intellectually handicapped? He always disappears whenever she turns her back at him and she never deem it suspicious. She also never saw her boyfriend and Alloyman at the same time even though she gets saved by him every day.
You: I don’t know about that. Maybe it’s just such a surreal thought that someone so close to her could be an Alloyman.
Bot: Physics don’t seem to work right. At several points of the movie people accomplish feats impossible to perform and the explanation of the science behind most of the gadgets is vague at best.
You: It’s fiction ok? The purpose of it is to be entertaining, not scientifically correct!
Bot: I get it. That explains why everything explodes at the tiniest impact.
…
We should have watched a drama after all…
